item.title: White House finalizes artificial intelligence oversight framework
item.description:
# White House finalizes artificial intelligence oversight framework The administration is preparing to brief leading AI companies on its blueprint for reviewing advanced AI models.
The framework will shape how the federal government works with the country’s leading AI developers before and after their most advanced models are deployed, and comes as the Trump administration seeks to address potential safety and national security risks while pursuing a mostly light-touch regulatory approach to the technology.
Anthropic, Google, Meta and OpenAI will be among the companies in attendance at the ONCD meeting, four of the people said.
Google, OpenAI and Anthropic jointly reviewed a draft and submitted edits in late July, as POLITICO [previously reported](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/07/27/openai-ceo-sam-altman-heads-to-washington-as-ai-policy-deadline-nears-01012970).

item.title: Master’s degree in artificial intelligence gets underway
item.description:
A new master’s degree in artificial intelligence (AI) being offered this fall at WSU will provide students with high-demand skills in AI and machine learning to meet industry needs around the state and region.
“Artificial intelligence and machine learning tools play a critical role in application development in many real-world engineering, science, and industrial domains, such as health or environmental informatics, physics, chemistry, additive manufacturing, bioinformatics, and cybersecurity,” said Doppa.
WSU’s School of EECS has a critical mass of faculty who are conducting cutting-edge research in AI and applied areas, ranging from AI for science and engineering, trustworthy AI, generative AI, and reinforcement learning, to interdisciplinary applications, such as the agriculture-focused [AI Institute for Transforming Workforce and Decision Support institute.](https://agaid.org/) The school has a strong [cybersecurity program](https://school.eecs.wsu.edu/academics/undergraduate-program/cybersecurity/) and is ranked among the [top computer science programs](https://csrankings.org/#/index?all&us) in the US in design automation, high-performance computing, and artificial intelligence.

item.title: Tokenpolitik: The new geopolitics of artificial intelligence
item.description:
An analysis by the Center for Strategic and International Studies argues that the strategic competition between the United States and China is entering a new phase, where the real prize is the ability to build the global infrastructure underpinning artificial intelligence.
- [Tokens are the basic units](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/ai-tokens-explained/) through which artificial intelligence models process information. Every prompt submitted to a chatbot, every generated text and every analysed image is broken down into tokens, which are converted into mathematical representations that neural networks can process.
